segs.en: Rem, Alex, José, and Abraham are spending the weekend exploring La Plata in the middle of the Training Camp Argentina. During their trip, they decide to visit an attraction called La República de los Pibitos.

zh.deepl: 雷姆、亚历克斯、何塞和亚伯拉罕正在阿根廷训练营的拉普拉塔度过周末。旅途中，他们决定去参观一个名为 La República de los Pibitos 的景点。

segs.en: The attraction consists of $$$n$$$ locations, numbered from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$. From each location, there is exactly one path leading to another location. Therefore, La República de los Pibitos can be represented as a functional graph: every vertex has exactly one outgoing edge.

segs.en: The graph is connected if the directions of the edges are ignored. Consequently, it contains exactly one directed cycle. Finding this cycle is one of the main attractions of La República de los Pibitos.

segs.en: For each hint, they may choose two integers $$$u$$$ and $$$k$$$ ($$$1 \le u \le n$$$, $$$1 \le k \le n$$$). Starting at vertex $$$u$$$, consider the sequence of vertices visited while following the unique outgoing edge exactly $$$k$$$ times. Thus, the sequence contains the starting vertex and the $$$k$$$ vertices reached after each step.

segs.en: You are the host of a large tournament that will feature $$$k$$$ athletes. You have $$$n$$$ familiar athletes, and you want to invite some of them to participate in a tournament. For each athlete, you know their strength and endurance (let's denote the strength of the $$$i$$$-th athlete as $$$p_i$$$ and their endurance as $$$s_i$$$). The $$$j$$$-th athlete will definitely defeat the $$$i$$$-th athlete only if they are strictly stronger and more enduring (i.e., if $$$p_j  \gt  p_i$$$ and $$$s_j  \gt  s_i$$$); otherwise, either of them could win.

zh.caiyun: 你是一场大型锦标赛的主办方，这场锦标赛将邀请 $$$k$$$ 运动员参加。你认识 $$$n$$$ 运动员，你想邀请他们中的一些人参加锦标赛。对于每个运动员，你都知道他们的力量和耐力 (让我们将 $$$i$$$ 运动员的力量表示为 $$$p_i$$$，耐力表示为 $$$s_i$$$)。$$$j$$$ 运动员只有在严格意义上更强壮、更耐力的情况下 (即 $$$p_j  \gt  p_i$$$ 和 $$$s_j  \gt  s_i$$$) 才能确定击败 $$$i$$$ 运动员;否则，他们中的任何一个都可能获胜。
zh.iflyrec: 您是以$$$k$$$运动员为特色的大型锦标赛的主办方。您有$$$n$$$个熟悉的运动员，您想邀请他们中的一些人参加锦标赛。对于每个运动员，你知道他们的力量和耐力(让我们把第$$$i$$$个运动员的力量表示为$$$p_i$$$，把他们的耐力表示为$$$s_i$$$）。第$$$j$$$名运动员只有在严格地更强壮和更持久的情况下(即，如果$$$p_j  \gt  p_i$$$和$$$s_j  \gt  s_i$$$），才一定会击败第$$$i$$$名运动员。否则，他们中的任何一个都可能获胜。
zh.ai: 你是一场将有 $$$k$$$ 名运动员参加的大型锦标赛的主办者。你认识 $$$n$$$ 名运动员，并且想邀请其中一些人参加锦标赛。对于每名运动员，你都知道他们的力量和耐力(记第 $$$i$$$ 名运动员的力量为 $$$p_i$$$，耐力为 $$$s_i$$$)。第 $$$j$$$ 名运动员必定击败第 $$$i$$$ 名运动员，仅当前者严格更强且更耐久时(即 $$$p_j  \gt  p_i$$$ 且 $$$s_j  \gt  s_i$$$)；否则，他们中的任意一人都可能获胜。

segs.en: The tournament proceeds as follows: as long as there are at least two athletes remaining, a pair is formed from two randomly selected athletes who have not been eliminated, the winner stays in the tournament, and the loser is eliminated. This continues until a tournament winner is determined.

zh.caiyun: 锦标赛的进行方式如下：只要至少还剩下两名运动员，就由随机选择的两名未被淘汰的运动员组成一对，获胜者留在锦标赛中，失败者被淘汰。这种情况持续进行，直到确定锦标赛的获胜者。
zh.youdao: 比赛过程如下：只要剩下至少两名运动员，则从两名未被淘汰的随机抽取的运动员中组成一组，获胜者继续比赛，失败者被淘汰。这一过程将一直持续到决出冠军为止。
zh.deepl: 比赛流程如下：只要至少还有两名运动员，就会随机抽取两名未被淘汰的运动员组成一对，胜者继续参加比赛，负者被淘汰。这样一直持续到决出比赛冠军为止。

segs.en: To make the tournament as spectacular and unpredictable as possible, you want to invite a set of exactly $$$k$$$ athletes such that the winner is not predetermined. In other words, for a fixed set of $$$k$$$ athletes and considering all possible outcomes of pairwise wins and losses, there will be at least two outcomes where tournament winners are different.

zh.caiyun: 为了使锦标赛尽可能地壮观和不可预测，你希望邀请一组精确的 $$$k$$$ 运动员，使得冠军不是预先确定的。换句话说，对于一组固定的 $$$k$$$ 运动员，考虑到所有可能的配对输赢结果，至少会有两种结果，其中锦标赛的冠军是不同的。
